# AP CSP Vocabulary Glossary

Every term from [`vocabulary-by-chapter.md`](vocabulary-by-chapter.md) (this book's own glossary) merged with every term from [`ap-vocabulary-coverage.md`](ap-vocabulary-coverage.md) (the full AP CSP exam vocabulary list), alphabetized into one binder-ready reference. Hosted twin: [`ap-vocabulary-glossary.html`](https://python.porttack.com/alignment/ap-vocabulary-glossary.html). Printable PDFs: [all terms](https://python.porttack.com/alignment/ap-vocabulary-glossary.pdf), [AP-tested only](https://python.porttack.com/alignment/ap-vocabulary-glossary-ap-only.pdf).

**300 terms. 144 are on the AP CSP exam's own vocabulary list (marked AP below); 212 appear somewhere in this book's chapters (chapter number(s) noted); 56 are both.**

Where this book uses a different word than the exam for the same idea (e.g. this book's `loop` vs. the exam's `iteration`), the entry keeps the book's word as the headword and notes the exam's name in parentheses -- the point is to recognize the exam's phrasing when it shows up on a test, not to relearn vocabulary you already have.

| **scaffolding** |  | 06 | Code that is used during program development but is not part of the final version. |
| **scalability** | AP | — | A system's ability to keep working acceptably as demand grows. |
| **semantic error** | AP | 02, 06b | An error that lets the program run but produces a wrong result. *(AP calls this a logic error.)* |
| **sequence** |  | 08 | An ordered collection of values where each value is identified by an integer index. |
| **sequencing** | AP | — | Executing steps in the order written. |
| **sequential computing** | AP | — | Operations performed one at a time, in order. |
| **serialization** |  | 13 | Converting an object to a string. |

| **shell command** |  | 08 | A statement in a shell language, which is a language used to interact with an operating system. |
| **side effect** |  | 06 | Any effect a function has other than returning a value, such as displaying output or drawing on a canvas. |
| **simulation** | AP | — | An abstraction of a real phenomenon using varying values to represent changing states, run for a purpose. |
| **slice** |  | 08 | A part of a string specified by a range of indices. |

| **special method** |  | 15 | A method that changes the way operators and some functions work with an object. |
| **specialization** |  | 17 | A way of using inheritance to create a new class that is a specialized version of an existing class. |
| **speedup** | AP | — | Sequential time divided by parallel time. |

| **statement** |  | 02 | One or more lines of code that represent a command or action. |

| **substring** | AP | — | A contiguous portion of a string. |
